questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Hymenolepis diminuta?
options: Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
questions.explanation: Embryonated eggs in stool. Wet mount/concentration at 100–400×; document size and absence of filaments in well-focused eggs.
